summary: Round 1, from scratch. Every generic arm so far ends on the start's traps: the control and --speed-equiv 1 slide into kill sheet *18 (5.69 / 5.86); per-call energy shaping K12 and the death charge + speed novelty make the agent camp on the platform (<= 3.1). Go-Explore never leaves the pit (energy lost to impacts); its energy-top pit states are doomed falls (benches 0/96), fixed by a new --admit-margin. New: GE found the record's post-pit corridor (a north-south trough under the platform) reachable WITHOUT the pit, via the platform's SW corner; running uf2r1b2_tc = backward curriculum on that 10 s GE line (west exit at 7.05%). Next: whether the policy pumps the trough for the west flight.
